What we provide

Our Security Services

Service arrangements can be tailored to each client's site, operating environment, hours and assessed requirements.

Mining & Industrial Site Security

Static guarding, site observation, perimeter awareness, workforce support and incident escalation for mining and industrial facilities.

Gate & Access Control

Visitor registration, vehicle entry and exit records, contractor sign-in, access checks and directions for authorised vehicles.

Mobile Security Patrols

Visible patrol presence, scheduled site checks, facility observation and reporting through agreed client procedures.

VIP & Executive Protection

Protective planning, client liaison and movement coordination for approved clients and assignments.

Event & Crowd Security

Entry-point assistance, visitor guidance, crowd observation and coordination with event organisers.

Workforce & Asset Protection

Agreed security procedures and visible presence to help protect employees, contractors, equipment, vehicles and business property.

Specialised protective operations

Armed Escort & Secure Movement

Escort support for eligible and approved assignments may include movement planning, client liaison, route coordination and appropriately trained personnel. Any armed component is conditional on all required company and personnel licences, permits and legal authorisations.
